text:
Maria (CS): Afternoon — quick ask. Kestrel wants an evening workshop this Fri at 18:00 CET to cover migration + dedicated capacity handoff. We need: facilitator for live demo, runbook owner, someone to collect feedback. Who's available?
Sam (CS): I can faciliate if it's mostly demo + Q&A. What local time does 18:00 CET land for APAC folks?
Priya (EMEA CS): 18:00 CET is 23:00 SGT — rough for APAC. Can we do 17:00 CET instead? Also we should record.
Jared (CS Ops): I can own the runbook and post-event artifacts + recording. If we keep a compact agenda it should fit 60m. Need calendar copy and lab access link.
Lina (Solutions): I can do the live demo (dedicated migration walkthrough) and handle the hands-on portion. Happy to pair with Sam for Q&A.
Sam (CS): :thumbsup: Lina — great. Priya — recording -> can you own start/stop? ops-bot can nudge but we need a person.
ops-bot: Heads-up: use /start-recording in Zoom or enable cloud recording before session. Add "Kestrel Workshop — Redwood" to the event title.
Maria (CS): Jared, can you drop a clean calendar description + agenda? Also need a short sign-up for lab seats (we usually cap hands-on to 5). @eng-ops should confirm Dedicated pool reservations.
Jared (CS Ops): Calendar copy below — ready to paste:

---
Title: Kestrel: Migration & Dedicated Handoff (Redwood)
When: Fri, [date] 17:00 CET (suggested) — 60 minutes
Agenda:
- 00:00–00:15 Intro & objectives
- 00:15–00:35 Live demo: migration checklist & dedicated config (Lina)
- 00:35–00:50 Hands-on lab (5 reserved seats)
- 00:50–01:00 Feedback + next steps
Notes: Recording enabled; slides + runbook will be shared after. RSVP required for lab access.
---

Jared (CS Ops): Lab invite command (ops):
```
lab invite --team kestrel-eng --access-level attendee --expires 72h
```

Priya (EMEA CS): That agenda works. If we stick to 60m, keep hands-on friction low — maybe pre-provision a minimal dataset. Also please record and capture the CS health note: customer lists renewal risk flag if migration blockers found. I'll monitor.
Sam (CS): I'll run a 1-question poll in #customer-success to confirm preferred time (17:00 vs 18:00 CET) and ask for an extra APAC-friendly Q&A volunteer.
Lina (Solutions): I'll prep slides and a short demo script. Can someone review by Thu 14:00?
Maria (CS): I can proof slides Thu morning. Jared — can you confirm Dedicated pool reservation and paste calendar once done?
Jared (CS Ops): Confirmed: requested 5 reserved slots from eng-ops. Calendar copy posted and RSVP link created: https://cal.example.com/kestrel-workshop (placeholder). I'll also publish the runbook to the CS wiki after the session.
Priya (EMEA CS): I'll own recording start/stop and take live notes. After the session I'll tag any churn signals into the renewal tracker.
Sam (CS): Volunteers so far: @Lina, @Jared, @Sam. Need 1 more volunteer for APAC-friendly Q&A (late hours). Anyone?
Lina (Solutions): I can handle quantization/config Q&A. @eng-ml feel free to chime in if available.
Maria (CS): Awesome — plan: move to 17:00 CET to be more APAC-friendly, recording on, 60m compact agenda, 5 reserved lab seats. Jared to create event + RSVP link, I'll send invites and the feedback form.
Jared (CS Ops): I'll create the event and add the runbook link. Post-workshop follow-up: I'll share recording + survey summary within 48h.
ops-bot: Event created: Kestrel Workshop — Fri [date] 17:00 CET. Recording enabled.
Maria (CS): Thanks all. I'll update the CS tracker with the session plan and the renewal-watch note. Ping me if anything changes. :rocket:
